agility_shuffle.c: Keep your hips low, chest up and take short side steps without crossing your feet.

aqua_jog.c: Run upright without touching the bottom, with high knees and a firm core.

arm_circles.c: With your arms straight out at shoulder height, draw big, controlled circles without shrugging your neck.

backbend_wheel.c: Press through your hands and feet, straighten your arms and legs and open your chest toward your hands without straining your neck.

basketball_dribble.c: Dribble with your fingertips, knees bent and your other hand protecting the ball.

basketball_shot.c: Extend your legs, elbow and wrist in one line and finish with your arm up.

bench_press.c: Lower the bar to your chest with control and press up without lifting your back off the bench.

bike_stationary.c: Pedal with a straight back and your knee in line with your toes.

boat_pose.c: Keep your chest open and your back long; if it's hard, bend your knees and lift only your shins.

box_jump.c: Use your arms to jump, land softly on your whole foot, stand tall on top and step down with control.

burpee.c: Drop into a plank with your body straight, come back to a squat and jump up with your arms extended.

butt_kicks.c: Jog in place bringing your heel to your glute, with your torso upright and your thighs almost vertical.

calf_stretch.c: Keep your back leg straight and your heel on the floor as you move your hips toward the wall.

cat_cow.c: Move your spine with your breath: inhale and open your chest, exhale and round your back.

childs_pose.c: Sit your hips back onto your heels, stretch your arms forward and relax your forehead toward the floor.

clean.c: Extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively and catch the bar on your shoulders.

climb_dyno.c: Sink down, push hard with your legs and throw your arm precisely to the high hold.

climb_flag.c: Stand on one foot and extend the other leg as a counterweight so you don't swing out.

climb_heel_hook.c: Hook your heel on the hold at hip height and pull with your leg to take the load off your arms.

climb_reach.c: Push with your legs, keep your hips close to the wall and only stretch out your arm.

cobra.c: Press through your hands and open your chest without lifting your hips off the floor; keep your shoulders away from your ears.

cross.c: Rotate your hip and rear shoulder as you throw the punch, then return to your guard.

crunch.c: Curl up until your shoulder blades lift off the floor, without pulling on your neck with your hands.

curl_db.c: Elbows tucked at your sides: curl the dumbbell up without swinging and lower it with control.

dance_arm_wave.c: Let the wave travel from shoulder to elbow to wrist, without tensing your neck.

dance_body_roll.c: Push your chest out, then your hips, like one continuous wave from top to bottom.

dance_hiphop_bounce.c: Bend your knees to the beat and let your arms and chest follow the sway.

dance_salsa_step.c: Step forward, back and together, shifting your weight with relaxed hips.

dance_side_step.c: Step to the side, bring your feet together and sway your hips with your arms.

dance_spin.c: Fix your gaze on one point, pull your arms in to your chest and turn on the ball of your foot.

deadlift.c: Keep your back neutral, the bar close to your body and push the floor away with your legs.

downward_dog.c: Press the floor away with your hands and send your hips up and back, lengthening your back.

elliptical.c: Keep your torso upright, push through your heels and alternate legs and arms.

face_pull.c: Pull toward your face with your elbows high and wide, and squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.

footwork_shuffle.c: Take short steps without crossing your feet and always keep your guard up and a steady distance between your feet.

forward_fold.c: Bend your knees slightly, send your hips back and let your torso drop, with your head and neck loose.

glute_bridge.c: Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top without arching your lower back.

golf_bunker.c: Dig your feet in, open the clubface and hit the sand behind the ball with a full swing.

golf_chip.c: Weight on your front foot, hands ahead of the ball and a short, low stroke without breaking your wrists.

golf_putt.c: Swing the putter like a pendulum from your shoulders, with firm wrists and a still head.

golf_setup.c: Bend your knees, tilt forward from your hips and let your arms hang relaxed.

golf_swing.c: Rotate your body without swaying, take the club up and finish with your weight on your front foot.

guard_stance.c: Knees bent, fists by your chin and elbows tucked against your body.

hamstring_stretch.c: With your leg straight, reach your chest toward your foot keeping your back long, without rounding it.

hangboard_hang.c: Keep your arms long, engage your shoulders down and bend your elbows slightly without swinging.

heavy_bag.c: Punch with your hips and shoulder, not just your arm, and get back to your guard quickly.

high_knees.c: Drive your knees up to hip height at a brisk pace, with your torso upright and your arms alternating.

hill_run.c: Lean forward from your ankles, take short strides and land under your hips.

hip_circles.c: With soft knees and a still chest, draw big, slow circles with your pelvis.

hip_flexor_stretch.c: With your back knee on the floor, squeeze your glute and push your hips forward without arching your lower back.

hook.c: Keep your elbow high and swing in an arc, rotating your torso and feet, without flaring your arm out too far.

inchworm.c: Walk your hands out to a plank, keep your core firm and walk back with short steps.

inverted_row.c: Keep your body straight like a board and pull your chest up to touch the bar.

jab.c: Extend your lead fist in a straight line and snap it back to your guard quickly.

jump_rope.c: Jump low, on the balls of your feet, and turn the rope with your wrists.

jump_squat.c: Lower with a straight back, jump powerfully and land softly with your knees bent.

jumping_jack.c: Open your legs and arms at the same time with a small jump and land softly with your knees bent.

kb_swing.c: The power comes from your hips, not your arms; keep your back straight throughout the hinge.

lateral_raise.c: Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight bend in your elbows.

leg_raise.c: Raise your straight legs to vertical, then lower them slowly without letting them touch the floor.

leg_swings.c: Lean on a wall and swing your straight leg forward and back without arching your back.

lunge_alt.c: Take a long step, lower straight down and push through your front heel to come back up.

lunge_db.c: Keep your torso upright, your front knee over your ankle and your back knee almost touching the floor.

mountain_climber.c: Keep your hands under your shoulders and your hips low as you drive your knees to your chest.

neck_rolls.c: Slowly circle your head without dropping it far back, keeping your shoulders relaxed.

ohp_db.c: Press up without arching your back and fully extend your arms overhead.

padel_volley.c: Racket up and in front, step forward and hit short without a long swing.

pallof.c: Extend your arms in front of you without letting the band twist your torso; keep your abs tight.

pigeon.c: Keep your hips square and lengthen your spine before folding forward over your bent leg.

plank.c: Keep your body straight from head to heels, with your abs and glutes tight.

pullup.c: Start with your arms extended and pull your chest toward the bar until your chin passes it.

pushup.c: Keep your body straight from head to heels, elbows close to your sides and chest almost touching the floor.

pushup_knees.c: Keep your body straight from head to knees and lower your chest almost to the floor.

quad_stretch.c: Bring your heel to your glute with your knees together and gently push your hips forward.

rdl.c: Keep your knees almost straight, push your hips back and slide the bar down close to your legs.

row_band.c: Keep your back straight, pull your hands to your abdomen and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

row_db_one_arm.c: Keep your back flat and drive your elbow toward your hip without twisting your torso.

rowing_machine.c: Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your chest.

run_easy.c: Relaxed stride, upright torso and arms at 90 degrees without crossing over your chest.

russian_twist.c: Lean back with a straight spine; twist from your torso, moving the ball from side to side.

shadow_combo.c: Chain a jab, cross and hook, rotating your hips and always returning to your guard.

shoulder_stretch.c: Bring your arm across your chest and gently pull on the elbow, without twisting your torso or raising your shoulder.

ski_carve.c: Lean your body into the turn, knees bent and weight on the outside ski.

slip.c: Move your head off the line of the punch by bending your knees, then return to your guard.

snowboard_turn.c: Bend your knees, change edges with your hips and open your arms for balance.

snowplough.c: Skis in a V, knees inward and hips low, pushing your heels outward.

soccer_dribble.c: Soft touches with the inside and outside of your foot, head up and the ball always close.

soccer_kick.c: Plant your foot next to the ball, swing your leg back and strike with your instep.

spinal_twist.c: Lengthen your spine as you inhale and twist from your torso as you exhale, keeping your hips on the floor.

split_squat_bulgarian.c: Lower straight down with your back foot on the bench and your weight on your front leg.

sprint.c: Lean your whole body forward, drive your knees up and pump your arms hard.

sprint_change_dir.c: Brake with your outside leg, drop your hips and push hard to take off the other way.

squat_barbell.c: Bar across your traps, chest up, and lower with control until your thighs are parallel.

squat_bw.c: Push your hips back, knees out and heels flat on the floor.

stair_climb.c: Place your whole foot on the step and push up with that leg, without pushing off your back leg.

sun_salutation.c: Link each movement to your breath: inhale as you rise and stretch, exhale as you fold down.

superman.c: Lift your arms and legs at the same time without straining your neck; look at the floor and squeeze your glutes.

surf_bottom_turn.c: Bend your knees, lean your body toward the wave and let your arm lead the turn.

surf_duck_dive.c: Press down with your chest and drive your knee onto the tail to sink the board and pass under the wave.

surf_paddle.c: Keep your chest slightly lifted and paddle with long, alternating strokes.

surf_pop_up.c: Push up with your arms and bring both feet under your body in a single jump.

surf_ride_stance.c: Feet apart, knees bent and arms out to keep your balance.

swim_backstroke.c: Keep your hips high, look at the ceiling and alternate your arms in circles.

swim_breaststroke.c: Pull with your arms, breathe as you come up and kick, bringing your legs together.

swim_butterfly.c: Undulate your body from your chest and bring both arms out together, with two kicks per stroke.

swim_freestyle.c: Lengthen your stroke, rotate your body and kick from your hips.

swim_kick_board.c: Kick with almost straight legs from your hips, keeping your ankles loose.

tennis_forehand.c: Turn your shoulders, hit out in front of your body and finish with the racket over your opposite shoulder.

tennis_serve.c: Toss the ball high, cock your arm back and hit up, stretching your whole body.

torso_twist.c: Keep your pelvis still and rotate from your torso and shoulders, letting your gaze follow the turn.

tree_pose.c: Place the sole of your foot on your thigh (never on the knee), focus on a fixed point and raise your arms.

triceps_ext.c: Elbows pointing up and close to your head; only your forearms move.

tuck_position.c: Thighs almost horizontal, back flat and hands out front, without lifting your hips.

uppercut.c: Bend your knees, drive up with your legs and bring your fist straight up toward the chin.

walk_brisk.c: Take long steps landing on your heel and swing your arms in opposition.

warrior_2.c: Bend your front knee to 90 degrees, keep your back leg straight and your arms active at shoulder height.
